rules: Every PASS retains its exact task, model, representation, numerical and recovery scope.
A completed negative experiment does not pass its positive acceptance gate.
A source publication after outcomes cannot retroactively qualify those outcomes.
No threshold, amortization count, strong comparator or statistical unit is relaxed after results.
Shared parent/child CPU is counted once; missing historical costs remain unknown.
GPU, energy, real-media or production evidence requires actual execution and attributable measurements.

original_core_gate.unit: eight independently trained fit seeds, conditional on fixed test pools
requirements: two-sided exact signflip with Holm across two domains < 0.05
original_core_gate.r19_result: FAIL: both domain mean differences and both 95% interval upper bounds are negative

original_cost_gate.r19_result: FAIL despite quality noninferiority and bounded cached/workspace arrays

content_reliability.fractional_answers: Registered runtime definition: max final posterior probability < 1-1e-9. Certain-answer totals cannot mask fractional selective errors.
content_reliability.r19_result: Original conditional calibration FAIL; repaired R19b trained-family calibration PASS; five-family confirmation FAIL.
content_reliability.unknown_law_limit: A local observational ambiguity theorem is not a substitute for marginal accepted-risk or empirical held-out-family gates.

continuum_limit: Slab value comparison and an ideal aligned-scheme theorem do not imply fixed floating-point convergence, general free-boundary regularity, full-finance gradients or a single global smooth solution.
production_limit: Finite native Q qualification, actual trained-model forward parity and private-owner pending recovery are separately checked. Production dispatch, native parameter-to-Q, network/host restart, real media and hardware adoption cannot be inferred by concatenating reports.
